notes: Adjudicated by reading MorphoLendingRouter.sol at the pinned commit. `initializeMarket` writes `s_morphoParams[vault]` at L46-49 and only then calls `MORPHO.createMarket(marketParams(vault))` at L51. Morpho refuses a market that already exists, and anyone may call its `createMarket` directly with the same params, so the revert at L51 rolls the mapping write back and L43-44 leave nothing written to retry from. An outsider can therefore make initialisation permanently impossible for a vault that needs it -- a revert an outsider controls on a path somebody else needs. The class is this adjudication's; the location is the report's, which stated L51 among three lines it cited, and L51 is the one a fix changes. The commit is inferred: the report's own links name a branch.
